title: Absent skills: Kubernetes, Kafka and Helm requested; RabbitMQ and Docker shown
provenance: Written for this evaluation. Not copied from any real job posting or resume.
job_description:
Platform Backend Engineer

Our order platform processes events from many services. You will build event-driven backends in Python, run them on Kubernetes and package them with Helm charts.

Responsibilities:
- Design services that publish and consume events on Kafka.
- Containerise services with Docker.
- Deploy and operate them on Kubernetes (k8s) and write runbooks.

Requirements:
- Python and FastAPI.
- Kafka or a similar message broker.
- Kubernetes, Helm and Docker.
- PostgreSQL.

Experience with event streaming at scale is a plus.
